name: cru
description: Cru's catalog of Claude Code plugins, including the Cornerstone Design System.

plugins.name: cornerstone
plugins.description: Cornerstone's front door, for everyone — the design-system assistant that answers token, theming and integration questions, plus the `/onboard` walkthrough for wiring the package into your project. Install this if you consume Cornerstone; install `cornerstone-dev` if you build it.

plugins.name: cornerstone-skills
plugins.description: General engineering and productivity skills for Cornerstone's contributor personas. Forked from mattpocock/skills (MIT) — see plugins/cornerstone-skills/NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: cornerstone-dev
plugins.description: The contributor tier — Cornerstone's front door plus the engineering skills and Figma tooling its contributor personas rely on. Install this if you work on Cornerstone itself.

plugins.name: cornerstone-designer
plugins.description: The designer tier — Cornerstone's front door plus Figma tooling and a Figma-only prototyping skill. Install this if you design with Cornerstone and don't write code.
